title: Predication fiber algebra
description: JSON Schema for a predication fiber algebra A_p = L^⋈^(E×E) at a single predicate p — pointwise twist product of a residuated lattice L over the entity-pair index E × E. An element of A_p is a function E × E → L × L. The schema captures the data: the parameter lattice L, the entity-set E, and the assignments mapping each entity-pair to a twist-product element {pos, neg}. Carrier-membership of pos and neg in L, well-formedness of every entity-pair key, and the pointwise lifting of bilattice operations are runtime checks.

lattice.description: The residuated lattice L that parameterizes the twist product L^⋈.

entity-set.description: The entity-set E indexing the entity-pair domain E × E.

assignments.description: Map from entity-pair-key '<subject>:<object>' to the twist-product element {pos, neg} ∈ L × L. Verifier checks every key has the form '<entity>:<entity>' with both halves in entity-set.entities, and that pos and neg are both in lattice.carrier.

predicate.description: Optional predicate-slug recording which predicate this fiber algebra is the A_p for. As an abstract algebra A_p is the same for every predicate; the subscript records the assignment-set's identity in a valuation.
